title: No more shouting!
body:
Excellent app kids are interested in quests asking for more ways to collect coins really great tool to help drive independence.

Nice and interactive, can send little notes and keep them on track 

Like the way I can add my own tasks or choose from the list. Tried it for a week and now purchased for the year .
author: task mama!

title: Obscenely expensive
body: Lovely app but far too expensive as subscription service only, not enough free functionality to even get a feel for it. Can not recommend at all, incredibly disappointing.
author: ScutsPuf
